name: East-West "Petroline" pipeline (Abqaiq → Yanbu)
analysis: The largest Hormuz bypass, from Abqaiq to Yanbu on the Red Sea, delivering crude onto a corridor exposed to Red Sea risk.
situation: Attacked in April 2026 and shut after drone attacks in September 2026.

name: ADCOP pipeline (Habshan → Fujairah)
analysis: From Habshan to Fujairah on the Gulf of Oman: the only bypass that loads directly outside the strait.
situation: Carries almost all UAE crude bound for India since Hormuz closed.

name: Goreh → Jask pipeline
analysis: Iran’s bypass to the Gulf of Oman, effectively non-operational.
